parent_objective: audit diagnostic-positive expanded sequence target mining result before optimizer or further expansion

public_gates: verify optimizer admission remains blocked or justify a later design
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat six accepted sequences as optimizer-ready without auditing diversity
do not lower target acceptance thresholds
do not add privileged actor inputs
hypothesis: M617 is diagnostic-positive but likely still too narrow for optimizer admission; the audit should decide whether to expand diversity, adjust candidate families, or move to a shadow sequence-head design.
success_criteria: audit summarizes M617 accepted and unaccepted evidence
audit explicitly compares accepted diversity against the pre-registered breadth target
audit blocks optimizer admission if diversity is insufficient
audit selects the next branch without training or PPO
failure_criteria: audit treats narrow accepted sequences as training-ready

decision_rule: M618 passes if it audits M617 repeatability and chooses the next no-training branch.
